description: One-launch short-sequence GDN-2 recurrent forward with in-kernel q/k L2 normalization and FP32 state.

initial_state.note: K-major, read-only and never aliased with final_state.

o.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

final_state.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Token-major BTHD inputs/output; K-major BHKV state; all tensors contiguous.
domain.gate_domain: Finite g<=0, 0<=erase_gate<=2 and 0<=w<=1. The public Python API calls this tensor b; g/b/w are activated by the layer.
domain.normalization: q and k are normalized in FP32 with eps=1e-6; q is then scaled by 128^-0.5.
domain.ownership: Each vector participant owns complete heads for all T; no head/state row crosses cores and no cross-core synchronization is used.
domain.aliasing: Inputs are read-only; o and final_state are fresh complete-overwrite outputs with disjoint storage.

default.reason: All arithmetic/state are FP32, but CCE register reductions may differ from the CPU reduction tree; bitwise equality is not required.

support.note: All cases executed through the canonical unit runner with requested_backend=cce, launcher=aclnn and backend_executed=true.

measured.static: ascriptor check: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 220 surface operations; CCE emit produced 266 lowered operations.
measured.simulation: Functional sim passed three scoped cases; pipesim passed the single-token and state-chain cases without a hazard or deadlock.
measured.board_cce: All five contract cases passed through the Ascriptor aclnn launcher. Output relative-L2 was 1.240e-7 to 4.169e-6 for H=1 and 1.669e-7 for the H=16 decode/prompt cases; maximum final-state relative-L2 was 9.108e-8.
measured.public_wrapper: BF16 real-prompt inputs passed with output relative-L2 0 and final-state relative-L2 6.167e-8. A T=4 launch and four chained T=1 launches produced identical output and state.
measured.latency: B1/T1/H16 BF16 public call, including casts and aclnn bridge: 88.165 us versus 148.400 us for the torch_npu composition (warmup 10, iterations 100, synchronized), speedup 1.683x.
measured.whole_model: The real 95B checkpoint passed packed-inference whole-model comparisons. BF16 prompt/step logits relative-L2 were 3.260e-3/3.186e-3 and maximum recurrent-cache relative-L2 was 9.154e-3 under a 1e-2 budget. FP32 logits were 1.391e-5/2.065e-5 and maximum recurrent-cache relative-L2 was 1.785e-4 under a 1e-3 budget. Argmax and cache offsets matched; bitwise equality was not required.

provenance.disposition: Formula and public tensor semantics were independently reimplemented; no Triton source was copied.
Reused the already measured one-head-per-vector-core ownership and two-pass resident-state pattern, with distinct GDN-2 channel-wise erase/write math and in-kernel q/k normalization.

release_scope.note: This repository-owned unit is not part of Ascriptor 0.1.0.
